title: Retry keeps execution and attachment identities distinct
canonical_summary: Replacement creates a new session and invocation card; same-session rerun preserves session identity and creates a fresh invocation/block/card; recovery and presentation changes do not replay execution.
gui_classification_reason: User-visible cards, retained output and copy behavior are directly affected; storage portion is consumed separately by SP-125.
negative_constraints: No invented liveness, successful completion, exact command attribution or lost history.
No blanket invalidation on ordinary resize.

title: Output reads preserve completeness and backing truth
canonical_summary: Distinguish empty, complete-so-far, final, partial and unavailable output; verify whole-range backing and coherent reads across concurrent mutations; preserve authoritative outcome separately.

negative_constraints: No invented liveness, successful completion, exact command attribution or lost history.

title: PM owns the terminal engine and process host
canonical_summary: PM-owned VT parser, grid and scrollback, logical selection, command-block overlay, renderer adapter and PTY process host use operating-system APIs directly. R1/R2 become PM engine/host acceptance criteria. Leading terminals remain study references with no code reuse.
gui_classification_reason: Rendering, selection and command overlay fidelity are visible terminal behavior.
negative_constraints: No third-party terminal emulator, parser or PTY-abstraction library in engine or host.
No reference-terminal code reuse, selected third-party core, implementation, WorkNodes or NodeSeeds.
acceptance_source: DECISIONS.md P1/P2/R1/R2 acceptance; interpreted under DL-035
compile_notes: Accepted decision materialized as prerequisite owner prose; no new engine/host PlanUnit compiled. Existing SMPFS-070 wording synchronized with its owner. This does not claim runtime acceptance.

title: Pin and own the Windows console package with disclosed OS fallback
canonical_summary: The PM release ships a version-pinned ConPTY/OpenConsole console component package with verified installation/provenance. Disclose fallback to the OS copy for absent, untrusted or incompatible bundle and show version-dependent capabilities through host provenance. Same-day acceptance supersedes the first OS-only answer.
gui_classification_reason: Host provenance and fallback/degraded status are user-visible.
negative_constraints: No unpinned, unverified or silently substituted console components or undisclosed fallback.
No widened Windows support, backend hot-swap or command replay.
